heading.en: Which way does a spin point?

hook.en: Every point on a spinning ceiling fan moves in a different direction. Yet we can give the rotation one direction: along the axis, by the right-hand rule.
hook.kn: ತಿರುಗುವ ಫ್ಯಾನ್‌ನ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ಬಿಂದುವೂ ಬೇರೆ ದಿಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಚಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಆದರೂ ಬಲಗೈ ನಿಯಮದಿಂದ ಅದರ ತಿರುಗುವಿಕೆಗೆ ಅಕ್ಷದ ದಿಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದೇ ದಿಕ್ಕನ್ನು ನೀಡಬಹುದು.

body.en: $\vec C = \vec A\times\vec B$ has magnitude $AB\sin\theta$ and points perpendicular to both A and B, as given by the right-hand screw rule. It is not commutative: $\vec A\times\vec B = -\vec B\times\vec A$. For unit *vectors* $\hat i\times\hat j = \hat k$, $\hat j\times\hat k = \hat i$, $\hat k\times\hat i = \hat j$, and $\hat i\times\hat i = 0$.
body.kn: C = A × B ಯ ಪರಿಮಾಣ AB sinθ ಮತ್ತು ದಿಕ್ಕು A ಮತ್ತು B ಎರಡಕ್ಕೂ ಲಂಬ (ಬಲಗೈ ತಿರುಪು ನಿಯಮ). A × B = −B × A. î × ĵ = k̂, ĵ × k̂ = î, k̂ × î = ĵ.

It is not commutative: vec A times vec B equals minus vec B times vec A. For unit vectors hat i times hat j equals hat k, hat j times hat k equals hat i, hat k times hat i equals hat j, and hat i times hat i equals 0. A times A equals 0; parallel vectors give zero.

title.en: Velocity on a spinning plate: v = ω × r
title.kn: ತಿರುಗುವ ಫಲಕದ ಮೇಲಿನ ವೇಗ: v = ω × r

narration.en: Every point of a rigid body rotating about a fixed axis moves on a circle with v = ω × r. The arrow at P shows the velocity of the plate's material there: it is perpendicular to r and of size ωr. ω itself is a vector along the axis, out of the screen for anticlockwise turning (right-hand rule).
narration.kn: ಸ್ಥಿರ ಅಕ್ಷದ ಸುತ್ತ ತಿರುಗುವ ದೃಢ ಕಾಯದ ಪ್ರತಿ ಬಿಂದು v = ω × r ನೊಂದಿಗೆ ವೃತ್ತದಲ್ಲಿ ಚಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. P ಯಲ್ಲಿನ ಬಾಣ ಅಲ್ಲಿನ ಫಲಕದ ವೇಗ: r ಗೆ ಲಂಬ, ಗಾತ್ರ ωr. ω ಅಕ್ಷದ ದಿಕ್ಕಿನ ಸದಿಶ; ಅಪ್ರದಕ್ಷಿಣೆಗೆ ಪರದೆಯಿಂದ ಹೊರಗೆ (ಬಲಗೈ ನಿಯಮ).

title.en: Angular velocity and its relation with linear velocity

body.en: In rotation about a fixed axis, every particle moves in a circle about the axis. The *angular velocity* $\omega = d\theta/dt$ is the same for all particles and points along the axis. A particle at perpendicular distance r from the axis has linear speed $v = \omega r$; in vector form $\vec v = \vec\omega\times\vec r$. Angular acceleration is $\alpha = d\omega/dt$.
body.kn: ಸ್ಥಿರ ಅಕ್ಷದ ಸುತ್ತ ತಿರುಗುವಾಗ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಕಣಗಳಿಗೆ ಒಂದೇ ಕೋನೀಯ ವೇಗ ω ಇರುತ್ತದೆ; ಅದು ಅಕ್ಷದ ದಿಕ್ಕಿನಲ್ಲಿರುತ್ತದೆ. ಅಕ್ಷದಿಂದ r ದೂರದಲ್ಲಿನ ಕಣದ ರೇಖೀಯ ಜವ v = ωr. ಕೋನೀಯ ವೇಗೋತ್ಕರ್ಷ α = dω/dt.

points.en: Points on the axis have v = 0

problem.en: Find A × B for A = 3î + 4ĵ and B = 2î.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Find A × B for A = 3î + 4ĵ and B = 2î.

say.en: Let us solve this together. Find A times B for A equals 3î plus 4ĵ and B equals 2î.
3î times 2î equals 6î times î equals 0.
4ĵ times 2î equals 8ĵ times î equals minus 8k̂.
A times B equals minus 8k̂, with magnitude 8.
So the answer is minus 8k̂.

problem.en: A wheel turns at 120 rpm. Find its angular speed and the speed of a point 0.5 m from the axis.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A wheel turns at 120 rpm. Find its angular speed and the speed of a point 0.5 m from the axis.

say.en: Let us solve this together. A wheel turns at 120 rpm. Find its angular speed and the speed of a point 0.5 metres from the axis.
120 rpm equals 2 rev/s, so omega equals 2 pi times 2 equals 4 pi is approximately 12.6 rad/s.
v equals omega r equals 4 pi times 0.5 equals 2 pi is approximately 6.3 metres per second.
So the answer is omega is approximately 12.6 rad/s; v is approximately 6.3 metres per second.
